modes.name: Bluetooth
modes.notes: Found by Scan like any Bluetooth LE device.
modes.how_to_add: Wake method Bluetooth: Scan while switching it on, add it.

modes.name: 2.4G dongle
modes.notes: Nordic Enhanced ShockBurst, 1 Mbit/s, 5-byte address, CRC-16. A fixed channel plus a hopping second channel while it searches for the dongle. The address is fixed per controller.
modes.how_to_add: Wake method 2.4G: Learn while switching it on with the dongle unplugged.
